# Browser assets

All runtime assets are self-hosted. Camera recognition never requires a third-party CDN.

- `jsQR-1.4.0.js`: jsQR 1.4.0, Apache 2.0. Original upstream artifact from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js`; SHA-256 `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`. License included.
- `dm-sans-latin.woff2`: Latin subset of the Google Fonts DM Sans variable font, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Source: `https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans`. Weight and optical-size variation preserved; font name unchanged. License included.

## Festival reference typography

The festival website uses Anton for headings and Inter for body text. Both font files below are self-hosted Latin subsets of the original Google Fonts distributions. Font names are unchanged and the SIL Open Font License 1.1 is included for each family. The Inter weight and optical-size variation axes are preserved. No third-party font request occurs at runtime.

- `anton-latin.woff2`: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/anton; SHA-256 `0c273168632110e982853eee6686462f42215b2bb500712c69a6dc101402e873`; license `Anton-OFL.txt`. Retrieved and subset on 2026-10-16.
- `inter-latin.woff2`: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter; SHA-256 `788519867a492e9b05344edfcfd3950fdbbb432f8c005997a778c4fc892c10c1`; license `Inter-OFL.txt`. Retrieved and subset on 2026-10-16.
